cases.explain: Господь is the subject of the verb "держит", so nominative case.

cases.translation: Listen to me, house of Jacob.
cases.explain: Дом is in apposition to the subject, requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: They hire a craftsman who makes a god.
cases.explain: Мастер is the direct object of the transitive verb "нанимают", so accusative.
The preposition "от" (from) always governs the genitive case.
The preposition "на" (on) governs the prepositional case for location.

cases.translation: Remember the former things of old.
cases.explain: Дела is the direct object of the transitive verb "вспомните", so accusative.

cases.translation: Bring it to mind again, transgressors.
cases.explain: The preposition "в" (in) governs the prepositional case when referring to location or state.
The verb "дарую" (grant) governs the dative case for the recipient.

reading.ru: Пал на колени Белл, склоняется Нево.
reading.question: What happens to the gods of Babylon?
options: Bel falls to his knees and Nebo bows
Bel and Nebo are lifted up
Bel and Nebo rule over all
reading.correct: Bel falls to his knees and Nebo bows
reading.explain: "Пал на колени Белл" — Bel has fallen to his knees, and Nebo stoops.

reading.ru: С кем вы меня сравните, равным кому сочтете?
reading.question: What does God ask the people?
options: With whom will you compare Me?
reading.correct: With whom will you compare Me?
reading.explain: God asks rhetorically "С кем вы меня сравните" — With whom will you compare Me.

reading.ru: Я Бог, и другого нет, я Бог, и нет мне равного.
reading.question: How does God describe Himself?
options: He is God and has no equal
He is powerful but not perfect
reading.correct: He is God and has no equal
reading.explain: "Я Бог, и другого нет" — I am God, and there is no other.

reading.ru: Я возвещаю о конце из начала, из древности о грядущем.
reading.question: What does God declare about the future?
options: He announces the end from the beginning
He hides the future from all people
He lets others decide the future
reading.correct: He announces the end from the beginning
reading.explain: "Я возвещаю о конце из начала" — I declare the end from the beginning.

reading.ru: То, что я сказал, я исполню, то, что задумал, сделаю.
reading.question: What does God promise about His plans?
options: What He says He will do, and what He plans He will accomplish
reading.correct: What He says He will do, and what He plans He will accomplish
reading.explain: "То, что я сказал, я исполню" — What I have said I will bring to pass.

reading.ru: Слушайте меня, упрямые сердцем, далекие от праведности.
reading.question: To whom does God speak in this verse?
options: Those who are stubborn-hearted and far from righteousness
reading.correct: Those who are stubborn-hearted and far from righteousness
reading.explain: God addresses "упрямые сердцем" — those stubborn in heart, far from righteousness.
